description:
intent=i043 snapshot=s14 branch=tasklet-napi-softirq-lock status=complete
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/ti/cpmac.c:727-734 confidence=high conclusion=cpmac_hw_error workqueue worker takes priv->rx_lock with plain spin_lock (732) while NAPI cpmac_poll takes the same lock under NET_RX softirq (420), so a same-CPU softirq can spin forever against the preempted worker (soft-lockup/DoS).
finding location=drivers/net/ethernet/silan/sc92031.c:1088-1103 confidence=medium conclusion=sc92031_tx_timeout takes priv->lock with plain spin_lock (1096) while the ISR-scheduled RX/TX tasklet takes the same lock in softirq (843); the missing spin_lock_bh lets the tasklet spin forever against the preempted timeout holder on one CPU (soft-lockup/DoS).
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/micrel/ksz884x.c:5249 conclusion=Follow up: read ksz884x.c rx_proc_task/tx_proc_task bodies and enumerate every hwlock acquirer's context (tasklet vs ethtool/ioctl/workqueue) to decide whether a plain process holder pairs with a softirq spinner on hwlock.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/natsemi/ns83820.c:754 conclusion=Follow up: read ns83820 rx_action tasklet body and classify misc_lock (754) and tx_lock (1310) acquirers as process vs softirq context to test the BH-disable invariant.
unresolved location=drivers/net/wireless/ath/carl9170/main.c:263 conclusion=Follow up: trace carl9170 tx.c/mac.c BA processing for a softirq-context acquisition of tid_info->lock to pair with the plain process-context acquisition in carl9170_flush_ba (main.c:263).
unresolved location=drivers/staging/rtl8188eu/hal/rtl8188eu_recv.c:1 conclusion=Follow up: read the staging rtl*/wlan-ng tasklet callback bodies and pair their locks against process-context (ioctl/SME/workqueue) plain spin_lock sites in the same files.
coverage_gap=NAPI poll functions were enumerated via netif_napi_add greps but only cpmac's poll (plus qtnfmac pearl/topaz polls reached via the resp_lock re-evaluation) was deep-read; NAPI polls of the many ethernet drivers with plain spin_lock (e.g. ns83820 tx_lock, ksz884x hwlock) were left unclassified.
coverage_gap=Lock correlation was textual, by lock-expression base name per file; locks reached through differently named pointer aliases, container_of indirection, or per-queue lock arrays between softirq and process sites could not be matched automatically.
coverage_gap=Only the tasklet callback body plus NAPI poll function and their same-file direct callees were treated as the softirq side; locks reached through deeper indirect calls (ops->, hw->, function-pointer tables, cross-file statics, rtlpriv->cfg->ops) were not resolved.
coverage_gap=Process-context sites that disable BHs via local_bh_disable() nesting or via spin_lock_bh on an outer lock around a plain inner acquisition were only manually resolved for the classified candidates (e.g. iwlegacy 1684->1742); the full tree was not audited for that pattern.
